text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- France withdraws from the U.S.-led Provide Comfort Operation in northern Iraq.
- Iraq and Turkey discuss gas pipeline.
- Iraq-Turkish joint economic commission discusses ways of increasing cross-border trade.
- Russia wants to buy more Iraqi crude under the oil deal with the U.N.
- Jordan to export $80 million worth of foodstuffs and goods to Iraq under the deal.
- Jordan also donates medicine to Iraq.
- Editorial criticising Turkey over ratifying a new air force to patrol northern Iraq.
- Interior minister says rate of crimes decrease.
- Four Iraqi children killed in Amarah, southern Iraq, when a bomb dropped during the Gulf War exploded.
